variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. A radically distinctive original mascot logo exploration for an indie offline translator called kat translator. ONE image, square warm off-white paper background. Black ink doodle of a scruffy, absurdly lanky cat sitting upright FULL BODY, slumped shoulders, tiny head, disproportionately long thin limbs, tail curled in an awkward hook. Eyes are two very small almost horizontal dashes; one ear flattened, utterly unimpressed expression, mouth just a small straight line. Personality: dry sarcasm and 'I am surrounded by idiots' but endearing, funny through posture not a smirk. Art direction: contemporary independent comic zine / deliberately naive marker drawing, spontaneous economy of line, memorable imperfect silhouette, thick rough black strokes with lots of empty space. ONE tiny cobalt-blue accent, perhaps inside one ear. No cute round face, no big shiny eyes, NO side-eye grinning cat head, no cream-and-mint palette, no dark background, no pixel art, no realistic fur, no neat generic vector mascot, no speech bubbles or props. Center full cat with generous margins. No text. This must feel like an idiosyncratic artist's signature character rather than AI corporate clipart.

Use case: logo-brand. ONE exceptionally simple black-and-white logo symbol for kat translator, an independent translation app with sarcastic cat identity. Art direction: bold Swiss graphic design meets sly visual wit. Solid BLACK horizontal rounded-oblong cat silhouette, tiny triangular ears on top, cropped to head only; face almost entirely black except TWO SMALL WHITE horizontal eye slits. One eye slit subtly shorter and raised, conveying deadpan dry skeptical judgment. NO visible nose, NO mouth, NO whiskers, NO neck, NO patches, NO fur. Cat is viewed slightly obliquely with deliberately broad low proportions, NOT a round cute kitten. The shape should be unmistakably cat but almost abstract, strong enough to stamp in one ink, with careful optical balance and beautifully confident contours. Place compact mark in central 55 percent of a clean white square with very generous whitespace. Exactly two flat colors, no shadows, no texture, no gradients, no letters, no border, no mockup, no extra symbols. High-end independent software logo, dry wit and intelligence rather than aggression. Design an original logo, not a familiar existing brand.

Use case: logo-brand. ONE square bold experimental mascot graphic for kat translator. Original bizarre cat character with an enormous elongated RED-ORANGE horizontal bean-shaped head, two tiny sharp ears, a small narrow pear-shaped seated body and oversized crossed forepaws. Very large pale lavender oval eyes cut off halfway by heavy drooping eyelids, tiny pupils looking UP in exaggerated eye-roll, mouth a tiny off-center straight dash. Dry sarcastic attitude, unimpressed and casually arrogant, hilarious without smiling. Full character, unexpected odd proportions, sits slightly off-axis but visually balanced. Contemporary independent animation poster / bold cut-paper collage aesthetic, sharp simple silhouettes, slightly irregular hand-cut edges, minimal screenprint texture. Acid-yellow opaque background, saturated vermilion character, lavender eyes, deep purple details, four colors only. No realistic fur, no black-and-white patches, NO previous cream mint navy look, no cute kitten anatomy, no pixel art, no soft 3D, no smirk, no eyebrows, no text, no props, no mockup. Large graphic character with generous breathing space, striking at thumbnail size. Deliberately strange but art-directed, memorable and suitable as a bold app mascot.
